title: Absolute singular-ideal containment from an annihilator bound
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $D$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], $B$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $d_B:D\to B$ an $R$-algebra map making $B$ finitely presented over $D$. Let $\pi\in R$ satisfy $\operatorname{Ann}_R(\pi)=\operatorname{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$. Write $p$ for its image in $D$, and $T=\{r\in D\mid\forall x\in D,\ p^2x=0\Rightarrow rpx=0\}$. If the ideal generated by $d_B(T)$ is contained in $H_{B/D}$, then $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/D}$ and $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/R}$, with $H$ the singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] and the $D$-algebra structure on $B$ induced by $d_B$. : Ideal.map dB.toRingHom (singularIdeal R D) ≤ singularIdeal R B

proof.text: Apply Algebra.singularIdeal_map_le_relative_of_annihilator_bound with the given dB, hfp, pi, hR and hbound to obtain map(dB, H(D/R)) <= H(B/D). Equip B with the D-algebra structure induced by dB; its scalar tower over R follows from dB.comp_algebraMap.

Reduce the desired inclusion using Ideal.map_radical_le, Ideal.radical_mono, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap and Ideal.span_le to proving that dB(f) is a smooth localization element whenever D_f is smooth over R. Such f belongs to H(D/R) by Ideal.subset_span and Ideal.le_radical. The relative bound places dB(f) in H(B/D), so Algebra.smooth_localization_of_mem_singularIdeal makes B_{dB(f)} smooth over D.

Construct the D_f-algebra structure on B_{dB(f)} by Localization.awayMap. IsLocalization.map_eq verifies its scalar tower over D, and IsScalarTower.to₁₃₄ gives the scalar tower over R. Algebra.FormallySmooth.localization_base (Submonoid.powers f) changes the base of its formal smoothness from D to D_f. Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_restrict_scalars_finitePresentation gives finite presentation over D_f, since D_f is finite type over D and B_{dB(f)} is finitely presented over D by smoothness. Together these give Smooth D_f B_{dB(f)}.

Compose Smooth R D_f with Smooth D_f B_{dB(f)} using Algebra.Smooth.comp. This places every mapped generator in smoothElements R B; the span and radical reductions finish the absolute inclusion. The argument also permits zero localizations, zero rings, and nilpotent generators, and introduces no nontriviality assumption.

lean.statement: theorem singularIdeal_map_le_absolute_of_annihilator_bound (R : Type u) (D : Type v) (B : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing D] [CommRing B] [Algebra R D] [Algebra R B] [IsNoetherianRing R] [FinitePresentation R D] (dB : D →ₐ[R] B) (hfp : @FinitePresentation D B _ _ dB.toRingHom.toAlgebra) (π : R) (hR : ∀ r : R, r * π = 0 ↔ r * π ^ 2 = 0) (hbound : Ideal.span (dB '' {r : D | ∀ x : D, (algebraMap R D π) ^ 2 * x = 0 → r * algebraMap R D π * x = 0}) ≤ @singularIdeal D B _ _ dB.toRingHom.toAlgebra) : Ideal.map dB.toRingHom (singularIdeal R D) ≤ singularIdeal R B
